selection: Selected checkpoint minimizes validation max-source normalized coordinate reconstruction; no p-ratio, mixed-transfer, or expert-derived quantity was used.
metric_scope: Coordinate MSE is in normalized-coordinate units. Train is diagnostic (5 networks/source/seed); validation is held-out (20 networks/source/seed); mixed_transfer is post-fit and only exists for shared recipes.
caveat: Shared and LJ-only recipes differ in retained-source composition, normalizer fit population, per-epoch steps, and stopping/exposure; their paired seed differences are descriptive, not a causal matched-training estimate.
